build_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock: build an EfficientGraphAttentionBlock with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs for molecular graph processing
build_EfficientGraphAttention: build an EfficientGraphAttention module with multi-head self-attention, frequency embeddings, and optional graph attention aggregation
run_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock_forward: run the EfficientGraphAttentionBlock forward pass with graph data, node features, and edge features to get updated representations
run_multi_head_self_attention: run the multi_head_self_attention method with input tensors, attention mask, and optional frequency vectors for graph attention
build_FeedForwardNetwork: build a FeedForwardNetwork with configurable MLP layers for node and edge feature transformation in graph neural networks
